query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Extract CRM list-entry records from Attio, join them with Attio company domains, and prepare a domain-to-owner mapping for downstream processing.
query_ground_truth.intent: Extract CRM list-entry records from Attio.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if list identifier unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Discover the target list using ATTIO_LIST_LISTS (match by list label; extract the nested id value).
[Optional (if list scope/record type unclear)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm list metadata using ATTIO_GET_LIST (validate expected parent record type and list configuration).

[Optional (if you need object context for parent_record_id)] [Prerequisite]: Enumerate available record objects using ATTIO_LIST_OBJECTS (pick the likely object slug/type for downstream interpretation).

[Optional (if you need stable field slugs/types or server-side filtering/sorting)] [Prerequisite]: Retrieve list attribute schema using ATTIO_LIST_ATTRIBUTES (identify entry_values slugs and value shapes, including status/stage-like fields).

[Required] [Step]: List rows using ATTIO_POST_V2_LISTS_LIST_ENTRIES_QUERY (provide required 'list'; paginate with offset/cursor up to the 500 limit; collect parent_record_id and entry_values per row).
[Optional (if actor/owner references must be human-readable)] [Next Step]: Resolve referenced_actor_id using ATTIO_LIST_WORKSPACE_MEMBERS (map by id.workspace_member_id and join back to rows).

[Fallback (if results are empty or entry_values shape is unexpected)] [Fallback]: Inspect one row using ATTIO_GET_LIST_ENTRY (confirm entry_values slugs/nesting), then re-run ATTIO_POST_V2_LISTS_LIST_ENTRIES_QUERY.
known_pitfalls: [ATTIO_LIST_LISTS] List identifiers are nested under an id object; don’t assume a flat id field.
[ATTIO_POST_V2_LISTS_LIST_ENTRIES_QUERY] The required input field name is 'list'; misnaming can fail validation or return unexpected results.
[ATTIO_POST_V2_LISTS_LIST_ENTRIES_QUERY] limit is capped at 500; full exports require continuing pagination with offset/cursor and may produce very large payloads.
[ATTIO_POST_V2_LISTS_LIST_ENTRIES_QUERY] Rows are nested (e.g., response.data.data) and entry_values fields are arrays that are often empty; treat empty arrays as missing values.
[ATTIO_LIST_WORKSPACE_MEMBERS] Join key is id.workspace_member_id (to match referenced_actor_id); responses may include personal profile fields—avoid outputting them verbatim.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Helper to read first value from array-shaped values (handles scalar, option-like, and reference-like shapes)
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
def first_value(values,key,default=None):
  arr=(values or {}).get(key) or []
  if not arr: return default
  v=arr[0] or {}
  return v.get('value') or (v.get('option') or {}).get('title') or v.get('full_name') or v.get('target_record_id') or default
```

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Extract a status/stage title from entry_values where the field stores a nested status object
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
def status_title(entry,slug):
  arr=((entry.get('entry_values') or {}).get(slug) or [])
  return ((arr[0] or {}).get('status') or {}).get('title') if arr else None
```

ATTIO_POST_V2_LISTS_LIST_ENTRIES_QUERY.description: Tool to list entries in a given list, with the option to filter and sort results. Use when you need to retrieve records that belong to a specific list with optional filtering and sorting.

list.description: A UUID or slug identifying the list to retrieve entries from

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 500.

path.description: Path array for sorting by related record attributes

field.description: Child attribute field for nested sorting

attribute.description: The attribute name to sort by

direction.description: Sort order: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending

items.description: Sort descriptor for list entry sorting

sorts.description: An array of sort objects used to sort results. Each descriptor must contain direction ('asc' or 'desc') and either attribute or path.

filter.description: Filter object using list-specific attribute slugs (NOT parent object attributes). Use ATTIO_LIST_ATTRIBUTES with target='lists' to discover valid attribute slugs for this list. Supports shorthand syntax (e.g., {'attribute_slug': 'value'}) for simple equality or verbose syntax with operators like $eq, $not_empty, $in, $contains, $lt, $gt. See https://docs.attio.com/rest-api/how-to/filtering-and-sorting for complete syntax.

offset.description: The number of results to skip over before returning. Defaults to 0.

ATTIO_LIST_LISTS.description: This tool retrieves all lists available in the Attio workspace, sorted as they appear in the sidebar. Returns list metadata only (names, IDs, configuration) — not the records/entries within those lists. To fetch actual list entries, use ATTIO_FIND_RECORD with appropriate filters. This tool is a prerequisite for many list-related operations. Requires the list_configuration:read permission scope.

ATTIO_GET_LIST.description: Tool to retrieve details of a single list in your Attio workspace. Use when you need to get information about a specific list by its UUID or slug.

list.description: A UUID or slug to identify the list.
